sources_are: Tracked V3 authority, migration manifest, benchmark plan, dataset cards, and active test profile.
quantitative_boundary: Current external stress evidence is incomplete at 42/90 and is reported only as execution status, never as a treatment comparison.

private_data_policy: The report records only counts and a combined integrity hash. No private response, prompt, source-memory text, secret, or machine-local private path is embedded.
